items.title: Autonomous AI Intrusions Are Here: Lessons from the Hugging Face Compromise
items.summary: Hugging Face disclosed an intrusion that, according to them, was driven end to end by an autonomous AI agent system.

items.title: From Indirect Prompt Injection to DNS Exfiltration in macOS Terminal
items.summary: This is a follow-up to my previous Terminal DiLLMa research, and there is a positive outcome: Apple fixed a macOS Terminal behavior that enabled a DNS-based data exfiltration technique.
